research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen official occupations; current first-person biography and parental-leave policy; 2025 Hansard speech; indexed employer RAP and 2015 corporate release; public professional-profile index. Direct APH page returned 403; employer PDF exceeded size limit.

Follow up employer-specific hours, exact appointment/cessation and leave for every commercial role; allocate the reported part-time years and three 18-month breaks without back-calculating dates from children’s ages.

Resolve 2001–03, 2005–07, 2008, 2011–12 and 2015–17 gaps; identify consulting entity/clients and Redfern paid/voluntary status, dates and overlaps; obtain Anglicare 2022 cessation/campaign arrangements.

Perth Airport is treated as private operating-company employment provisionally; obtain contemporaneous operator/control evidence before any counted interval. No public employment is established, which does not prove zero.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: AGSM MBA 2002–2003 resolves provider gap; UWA lists LLB 1998. Added four board roles with profile dates and official corroboration; Trust official commencement differs from profile, and official retirement by June 2018 conflicts with profile July 2018.

Anglicare annual report says farewell after May 2022 election; RAP February working-group endpoint is not job cessation. No Fibs first-person 17-year part-time account differs from Hansard 16 years; neither permits exact employer allocation or FTE.

Searches for employer-specific part-time status and historical airport records did not settle hours/control. State Recovery Advisory Group search result appears adjacent to another member in multi-person article; not attributed without primary evidence. Next leads: dated Wesfarmers/Anglicare contracts and leave, airport ownership reports, precise Trust resignation, Redfern remuneration and consultancy clients.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: public professional-profile text documents the WAC role's retail, ground-transport and aviation business-development remit. The contemporaneous 2007–08 employer report and 2005 parliamentary ownership evidence establish that WAC was a privately owned operator under Commonwealth lease, resolving the provisional control classification. Exact appointment/cessation, hours, leave and reported part-time allocation remain unresolved.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Next25 annual report narrows board end to22January2022; explicitly separates its retirement label from Anglicare payroll. New primary government minutes document SCF candidate-related leave until1June2022; recorded separately as governance with unknown commencement/actual return, not Anglicare leave.2019–2020report supplies N/A remuneration observation; Forum working-group membership corroborates Anglicare representation. Employer-specific part-time/Redfern searches still lack boundaries, hours or pay. SEEK vacancies are employees in MP’s office, not her former workload.

Follow-up2026-10-05: Provider alumni table plus accessible April2019interview identify omitted Perth Executive Colloquium2018, added as excluded short-course study overlapping Anglicare, not employer leave. Primary circular-economy contributor table printed7/PDF4 expands Wesfarmers sustainability role to community partnerships. LinkedIn index exposes Mar2009–May2011 but adjacent role association inaccessible999; preserve official years pending full context. AIMWA interview gives broad two-decade career, not hours; job advertisements describe staff positions and rejected again. No new employer-specific part-time/leave/Redfern pay evidence; future targeted primary contracts/CV needed.
